Let me also think about what the goal might be. The top container has a blue token pattern. The bottom-left container also has a blue pattern. Maybe the goal is to match one of these patterns with the orange/blue blocks?
Actually, let me look at the bottom-left container more carefully. It has a blue L-shape. The top container has a different blue pattern. The orange/blue blocks are rectangular (5x2 orange + 5x3 blue).
Wait, I just realized something. The blocks are currently at rows 20-24, which is in the narrow neck of the gray structure. Looking at the image, the orange/blue blocks are right below the top container. Maybe the goal is to have the blocks in this position, and then do something else?
Let me try pressing DOWN to move the blocks back down, then try a different sequence. Or maybe I should try RIGHT again when the blocks are at a different position.
Actually, let me reconsider the entire game. Maybe the goal is to move the blocks to a position where they "fit" into the top container, matching the blue token pattern. Let me try a different approach. Maybe I should reset the blocks to the bottom and try a different sequence of actions.
